seriesTitle: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Girl with the Short Skirt

episodes.title: The Class Monitor is a Klutz/The School Girl's Friends Get Involved With The Klutz/The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Health Representative
episodes.summary: Poem learns the nagging class monitor is an idiot who lives nearby. Her friends learn they're growing close.

episodes.title: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Library Assistant / The Time She Spent Lunch With the Klutz
episodes.summary: Poem meets the handsome librarian who's mousey when away from his books. Then she looks for her missing lunch.

episodes.title: The Older Gal Who's Close to the Klutz/The Student Council of the Klutz's School
episodes.summary: A mysterious, sexy gal appears and gets a pass from Togo. The student council raises money for disaster relief

episodes.title: A Day Off With The Klutz/The Klutz Gets Plunged Into Battle On The Streets
episodes.summary: Togo enjoys breakfast with Poem's mom and little sister. While shopping, he rap-battles and meets her dad.

episodes.title: The Klutzy Health Representative and the Schoolgirl Who Slips Often / Taking More Supplementary Lessons With the Klutz on the Day Her Little Sister Is Touring the Klutz's School
episodes.summary: Poem and Tasaki try to help Akina hook up with Izubuchi. Togo and Poem's little sisters tour the school.

episodes.title: Drawing BL of the Klutz / The Klutz Studies Diligently / Buying Swimsuits to Hang Out With the Klutz's Friends
episodes.summary: After school, feeling bored, Mihomi impulsively asks to visit the manga research club that Tasaki belongs to. However, the manga research club that Mihomi steps into is an unknown world full of things she doesn't know. On another day, Sakuradaimon, Akina, and Tasaki gather at Mihomi's house to study for a test.However, Mihomi and the others don't start studying at all. Then Sakuradaimon says, "I'll be taking my leave now," and leaves the room...

episodes.title: Having Fun at the Beach With the Klutzes
episodes.summary: Togo, Poem, and the others all enjoy a fun time at the beach. Nadeko tries to make Kogori see her as woman.

episodes.title: The Klutz Suddenly Had An Earnest Look In His Eyes
episodes.summary: Togo & Poem go for a late night stroll and he agonizes over rejecting her invitation. Then at Enoshima Shrine-

episodes.title: The Klutz and the High School Girl's Summer Break Plus the Start of Their Second Semester
episodes.summary: "It seems I... like you."The confession Sakuradaimon made to her on Enoshima Island has been stuck in her head. Three days have passed since she returned from her trip, but...Three days have passed and she hasn't heard from Sakuradaimon!Growing impatient, Miho waits for him in front of his house as he goes out on his daily patrol! Shefollows him on patrol, hoping to find out how he really feels...

episodes.title: The Klutzes Prepare For The Cultural Festival
episodes.summary: It's almost time for the school festival at Komazawa High School, where Sakuradaimon and Hohoemi attend. Akina is actually on the school festival committee!A class meeting is immediately held to discuss the class's performance. Akina, who has an extraordinary passion for the school festival, proceeds with great enthusiasm..."The school festival is the biggest chance for romance in high school!"Akina declares proudly! Of course, her goal is a chance to get intimate with Izubuchi!

episodes.title: The Klutzes Enjoy the Cultural Festival
episodes.summary: Sakuradaimon and Hohoemi have been fighting and are now facing the school festival. Their promise to walk around the festival together remains unfulfilled. Hohoemi doesn't want the festival to end like this, so she goes looking for Sakuradaimon...Meanwhile, Akina and Izubuchi are going around promoting the prom dance party. Akina is happy to be alone with Izubuchi, but they run into some students badmouthing the dance party...

episodes.title: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Girl with the Short Skirt
episodes.summary: The prom dance party is finally about to begin. As students gather in the gymnasium one after another, Sakuradaimon and Hohoemi, Akina and Izubuchi, the student council president and vice president, each enter the gymnasium with their own separate thoughts and feelings.And there, Sakuradaimon and Hohoemi meet in the gymnasium.They had promised to go around the cultural festival together, but an awkward atmosphere develops between them. In the end, they were unable to go around the cultural festival together.Will Sakuradaimon and Hohoemi be able to make up...?
